description: Get the total amount sent to a single recipient (Moneda user, external bank, or external wallet) over a window. Identify the recipient by their account ID (recipientAccountId). Amounts are in currency units (26.5 means 26.50), like `get_transactions`.

from.description: ISO 8601 UTC start of an absolute window

period.description: Rolling time window. Mutually exclusive with from/to.

to.description: ISO 8601 UTC end of an absolute window

name: get_spending_by_contact
